newsitem.title: USA: Virginia returns Republican Sen. John Warner.
newsitem.headline: Virginia returns Republican Sen. John Warner.

text.p: Virginia Republican Sen. John Warner Tuesday beat back a stronger-than-expected challenge from telecommunications executive Mark Warner to win a fourth six-year term in the Senate, according to television networks.

Sen. Warner angered many in his own party when he refused to support Iran-Contra figure Oliver North, who made an unsuccessful Senate bid as a Republican two years ago. But he survived a challenge by state conservatives, a $9 million advertising blitz by Democrat Mark Warner and a certain amount of confusion over their identical last names to come out ahead.
